s1.syndrome_frame: Asymptomatic facial swelling with reduced mouth opening and prior similar episodes
salient_findings: Asymptomatic swelling in the right lower half of the face
Reduced mouth opening
Gross right facial asymmetry
Ovoid subcutaneous swelling with ill-defined borders
Elevation of the right buccal mucosa
key_facts: First episode treated as a buccal-space infection
Elevation of the right buccal mucosa
Contrast-enhanced CT showed a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas

raw.syndrome_frame: Asymptomatic facial swelling with reduced mouth opening and prior similar episodes
salient_findings: Asymptomatic swelling in the right lower half of the face
Reduced mouth opening
Gross right facial asymmetry
Ovoid subcutaneous swelling with ill-defined borders
Elevation of the right buccal mucosa
key_facts: First episode treated as a buccal-space infection
Elevation of the right buccal mucosa
Contrast-enhanced CT showed a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas

shortlist.label: Buccal space abscess
shortlist.why_kept: History of similar episodes and current presentation of facial swelling with cystic areas in the right buccal space

shortlist.label: Dentigerous cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas and elevation of the right buccal mucosa

shortlist.label: Salivary gland tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Restricted mouth opening and gross right facial asymmetry

shortlist.label: Odontogenic myxoma
shortlist.why_kept: Ill-defined borders and soft to firm consistency of the swelling

shortlist.label: Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Normal overlying skin and absence of lymphadenopathy or paresthesia

raw.rationale: The patient's history of recurrent episodes of swelling in the same area, the presence of a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas on CT, and the clinical diagnosis of a nonspecific chronic abscess with buccal-space involvement support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Dentigerous cyst
rejected.why: No mention of an associated tooth or radiographic evidence of a cyst associated with an unerupted tooth

rejected.label: Salivary gland tumor
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and imaging findings do not suggest a salivary gland tumor

rejected.label: Odontogenic myxoma
rejected.why: The imaging findings do not show a characteristic soap-bubble appearance of an odontogenic myxoma

rejected.label: Lipoma
rejected.why: The presence of cystic areas and the patient's history of recurrent episodes of swelling are not consistent with a lipoma
